messages.subject: For Antonio Filosa | Global mobility, government relations and stakeholder execution
messages.body:
Dear Stellantis Communications Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Antonio Filosa, Chief Executive Officer.

Stellantis' global transformation across brands, technologies, manufacturing and regional markets depends on disciplined alignment across governments, regulators, communities and strategic partners. That interface closely matches my current leadership mandate.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities span government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory, with senior institutional engagement across complex regulated operations.

I would welcome a senior conversation about where this combination of government relations, industrial stakeholder strategy and emerging-market execution might support Stellantis' priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Stellantis.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
https://ragunauthramsaroop.com/
